title: Nvidia shows AI harness, not just model, key to mastering long tasks with perfect benchmark score
summary: Nvidia shows AI harness, not just model, key to mastering long tasks with perfect benchmark score Pluang
body: Nvidia shows AI harness, not just model, key to mastering long tasks with perfect benchmark score Pluang
summaryZh: 英伟达通过研究指出，在攻克长周期、复杂任务并取得完美评测成绩时，除了基础大模型本身，外部的AI任务控制框架（Harness）同样起到了关键作用。原始信息显示：Nvidia shows AI harness, not just model, key to mastering long tasks with perfect benchmark score Pluang。该消息由Pluang发布，主题为“Nvidia shows AI harness, not just model, key to mastering long tasks with perfect benchmark score”。其重要性主要体现在：英伟达指出AI评测和任务执行中外部控制框架（Harness）的重要性。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
